"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student

COLUMN_GAP = 2


def check_contactable(students: List[Student]) -> None:
    """Raise when there is nobody to list or someone has no email."""
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ValueError(f"no email for student: {student.display_name}")


def align_columns(cells: List[List[str]]) -> List[str]:
    """Pad every column to its widest cell and join the rows."""
    widths = [max(len(cell) for cell in column) for column in zip(*cells)]
    gap = " " * COLUMN_GAP
    return [
        gap.join(cell.ljust(width) for cell, width in zip(row, widths)).rstrip()
        for row in cells
    ]


def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    check_contactable(roster)
    return align_columns([[s.display_name, s.section, s.email] for s in roster])


# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


def student(last, first, section, email):
    return Student(last + first, last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows([student("Zed", "Al", "A", "z@x.org"), student("Abe", "Bo", "B", "a@x.org")])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Abe, Bo"))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Zed, Al"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows([student("Longname", "Al", "A", "l@x.org"), student("Li", "Bo", "B", "b@x.org")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].index("b@x.org"), rows[1].index("l@x.org"))
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], "Li, Bo       B  b@x.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            contact_rows([student("Abe", "Bo", "A", None)])
        self.assertIn("Abe, Bo", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])


# end of file
EOF
